items.headline: Albemarle Corp: Investor Day on Aug 12, 2026 - Slides
items.snippet: Lithium demand diversifying in both application and geography as stationary storage gains market share. Lithium demand exceeding expectations, growing faster than supply. Long-term growth driven by stationary storage and EV; lithium demand expected +15-40% Y/Y in 2026.

items.headline: Albemarle Swings To Q2 Profit
items.snippet: Albemarle Corp. posted a profit for the second quarter, as revenues rose driven by stronger lithium pricing in its Energy Storage business. Net sales increased 31.1% to $1.74 billion from $1.33 billion last year.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $161 from $189 at Morgan Stanley
items.snippet: Morgan Stanley analyst Vincent Andrews lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $161 from $189 and keeps an Equal Weight rating, saying lithium prices have come off this cycle's peak.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist analyst Peter Osterland lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $225 from $245 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares, citing resilient lithium demand and constrained supply dynamics.
